kind: pre-registration of a practice screen on the server's GPU in the weekend's window: the stack's loop of two families and the Transformer's of one, each with six seeds of a loss that also learns from attempts below their task's mean
why: In practice_several_families.json four of the stack's nine runs and one of the Transformer's three fell, each just past the longest chain that the rehearsed corpus writes. The stack's fallen runs write the chain's first four names (three steps of the lookups that add) and then fill the room with one name repeated or with equals signs, ending on one digit whatever the task; the Transformer's writes three names and a guessed digit at every length. After a fall the stack's staircase goes between 4 and 5 steps, where 0.136 to 0.266 of the attempts are paid, many of them by a digit guessed after the filler. The loop's loss there teaches only from attempts above their task's mean (--dips 0): a paid guess after filler teaches as much as a paid chain, and an attempt that fills the room is never made less likely. --dips 0 was chosen in practice_within_reach.json, before rehearsal, to model a synapse strengthened by a burst of dopamine and barely weakened by its pause; with it, rehearsal held every run of practice_cap_raised.json (one family, from chain-stack) and not of practice_several_families.json. In the brain the pause is not idle. Dopamine neurons fall silent when an expected reward fails to come (Schultz, Dayan and Montague 1997), and the striatal neurons of the indirect pathway, through D2 receptors, learn from those pauses what not to do again; without that half, learning from bad outcomes fails (Frank, Seeberger and O'Reilly 2004). A loss with GRPO's dips at their full weight (--dips 1) lowers the likelihood of every attempt below its task's mean as it raises those above it, so an attempt that fills the room and is paid less often than the task's mean is made less likely, where under --dips 0 it was never made less likely. practice_within_reach.json's arm with dips and without rehearsal (cap-stack) lost its chains once nothing was paid; with rehearsal the lengths of 1 to 4 steps stay paid, so the loss always has attempts that disagree.
change: --dips 1 in place of --dips 0 (experiments/practice_loop.py, policy_loss: the GRPO loss as published, the advantages of the attempts below their task's mean kept at full weight). Nothing else changes: the loop, the staircase, the cap at 12 steps, the rehearsal of 16 tasks a family a round at 1 to 4 steps, Adam at 3e-5 clipped at 1, 2,000 rounds, room for 64 bytes, the code copy v18q (d0f53e2), the bases, the evaluations and the marks of practice_several_families.json.

arms.dips-stack-s0 ... -s5: the stack from four-stack, both families practised in the same rounds (the all arm of practice_several_families.json) with --dips 1, seeds 0 to 5: --families hops offs --longest-hops 12 --rehearse 16 --evaluate-hops 2 4 8 12 --exact-products --fused-reads --dips 1 --seed N
arms.bursts-stack-s3 ... -s5: the same with --dips 0, seeds 3 to 5: practice_several_families.json's all arm with new seeds. With all-stack-s0, -s1 and -s2 of that record (seeds 0 to 2, the same code, base and flags) they make six runs with --dips 0, paired by seed with the six of --dips 1.
arms.dips-tf-s0 ... -s5: the Transformer from four-tf-chain, the hop family (amendment_1 of practice_several_families.json) with --dips 1, seeds 0 to 5: --families hops --longest-hops 12 --rehearse 16 --evaluate-hops 2 4 8 12 --dips 1 --seed N
arms.bursts-tf-s3 ... -s5: the same with --dips 0, seeds 3 to 5; with hops-tf-s0 to -s2 of practice_several_families.json six runs with --dips 0, paired by seed.
arms.seeds: A seed draws the run's tasks and attempts, so the two arms of one seed start from the same weights on the same first tasks and part where their losses first differ. The stack's runs take --exact-products --fused-reads, the Transformer's neither, as before.

where: The server's GPU 1 in the weekend's window, after line_heads.json's runs and the full-length run of full_size_power_cells_second_seed.json, and before the full-size runs queued behind them (fs-loop6-lift-pc3 and the data-slope runs of full_size_data_slope.json, which start later than planned and still end inside the window): the stack's nine runs side by side under MPS (as practice_several_families.json's nine), then the Transformer's nine, three at a time; never the two models together.
measure: practice_several_families.json's: along the way, before the first round and every 100 rounds, 200 tasks of 2, 4, 8 and 12 steps a family; after the last round experiments/practice_loop.py --evaluate 1 2 3 4 5 6 8 12 16 --evaluate-tasks 200 --max-bytes 64 --seed 0 for every family of the run; its marks (kept, held, reach, reach kept) and a run holds as there. Every fallen run's answers are counted by form (experiments/forms_families.py on the server's CPU).

reading.(1) the stack stands: The dip keeps the stack's loop standing if all six dips-stack runs hold. If any of them falls, it does not, and its fallen runs are read for how they fell.
reading.(2) what the dip costs the stack: For each family, the share of whole chains at 12 and at 16 steps after practice: the mean over the dips-stack runs that hold against the mean over the bursts-stack runs that hold (seeds 0 to 5). The dip costs reach if its mean is at least 0.10 below at either length in either family; it adds reach if at least 0.10 above at either length in some family and below by 0.10 nowhere.
reading.(3) the Transformer stands: The same as (1) for dips-tf-s0 to -s5.
reading.(4) the stack against the Transformer, b: Whole chains of the hop family at 12 steps after practice, dips-stack against dips-tf, seed by seed: one model practises further if it is ahead (at least 0.10 higher with the 95% intervals apart) in at least four of the six seeds and behind in none. The bases differ as practice_several_families.json says (four-tf-chain had 24,000 updates on the hop family before the four families; the Transformer's rounds rehearse one family, the stack's two), which is said with every line.
reading.reported and not read: Every cell of every run, the falls among the runs with --dips 0 (three seeds of each model new), the staircases, the share of paid attempts without the whole chain, the rehearsal's loss, and how each fallen run writes.
reading.scope: Synthetic tasks of two families and one: whether learning from attempts below their task's mean keeps a practice loop with rehearsal standing past the lengths it rehearses. Not a claim about reasoning in language.

what follows: If (1) holds and (2) finds no cost, --dips 1 is the practice loop of the one-model plan from here on, and practice_several_families.json's questions (together or in turns, and how few families need practice of their own, reading (4) there) are asked again with it. If (1) holds with a cost, the cost is weighed against the falls it prevents in that next registration. If (1) fails, the fallen runs are read before the next candidate is chosen: replay of the model's own paid chains past the rehearsed lengths (the hippocampus replays rewarded paths), or a cap whose guess pays under the staircase's lower mark.
seen_before_recording: practice_several_families.json with result_stack and result_tf, including every run with --dips 0 that this record counts among its controls (all-stack-s0 held, -s1 and -s2 fell; hops-tf-s0 fell, -s1 and -s2 held) and how the fallen runs write. No run with --dips 1 and rehearsal has been made on either model. line_heads.json's two runs were training and full_size_power_cells_second_seed.json was registered when this was recorded.

result_stack.runs: practice-stands-a on the server's GPU 1 (MPS, nine stack runs side by side), 2026-11-28 04:00 to 06:39 UTC, code v18q (d0f53e2), base four-stack: dips-stack-s0 to -s5 (--dips 1) and bursts-stack-s3 to -s5 (--dips 0). The --dips 0 controls of seeds 0 to 2 are all-stack-s0 to -s2 of practice_several_families.json (same code, base and flags). Every run finished its 2,000 rounds and its evaluation after practice. reading.(1) the stack stands: Does not hold. Four of the six dips-stack runs hold (seeds 0, 2, 4, 5). dips-stack-s1 has reach in both families after practice but does not keep it in the offset family at every one of the last five evaluations. dips-stack-s3 keeps 1 to 4 steps in both families (0.996 and 0.991) but loses reach in the offset family (8 steps 0.280 / 0.190 after practice) and does not keep it in the hop family (8 steps 0.855 / 0.830 after practice; along the way 0.465 at round 1,700). Neither fell as the --dips 0 runs fall: their answers keep the chain's length (mean bytes 22 to 33 at 8 steps), none fills the room.
reading.(2) what the dip costs the stack: By the letter the dip costs reach: the mean whole chains of the dips runs that hold are below those of the --dips 0 runs that hold by at least 0.10 at both lengths in both families. But only one --dips 0 run holds (all-stack-s0, against four of --dips 1), so the comparison is four runs against one. {"hops at 12": {"dips (runs that hold)": 0.7987, "bursts (runs that hold)": 0.985, "dips minus bursts": -0.1863}, "hops at 16": {"dips (runs that hold)": 0.4338, "bursts (runs that hold)": 0.98, "dips minus bursts": -0.5462}, "offs at 12": {"dips (runs that hold)": 0.4725, "bursts (runs that hold)": 0.94, "dips minus bursts": -0.4675}, "offs at 16": {"dips (runs that hold)": 0.1338, "bursts (runs that hold)": 0.895, "dips minus bursts": -0.7612}}
reading.(3) and (4): Wait for the Transformer's runs (dips-tf-s3 to -s5 were practising when this was recorded).

reported and not read.falls with --dips 0: Five of the six --dips 0 runs fell: all-stack-s1, -s2 (practice_several_families.json) and bursts-stack-s3, -s4, -s5 (new). Each keeps 1 to 4 steps (0.989 to 1.000) and writes no whole chain at 6 steps or more (0.000, one cell 0.045); their answers fill the 64-byte room (mean bytes 54 to 64), as the four runs that fell in practice_several_families.json did. Only all-stack-s0 held (12 steps 0.985 / 0.940, 16 steps 0.980 / 0.895 whole chains in hops / offs).
reported and not read.with --dips 1: No run fills the room. The four that hold reach 8 steps at 0.920 to 0.980 (hops) and 0.770 to 0.960 (offs) whole chains, but fewer reach far: at 16 steps 0.015 to 0.905 (hops) and 0.000 to 0.425 (offs). Paired by seed against --dips 0, --dips 1 holds where --dips 0 fell in seeds 2, 4 and 5, both fall in seeds 1 and 3, and seed 0 holds under both (with --dips 0 further at 12 and 16 steps).
reported and not read.forms: The answers of the runs that did not hold are being counted by form (forms_families.py on the server's CPU, job stands-forms); they follow in result_tf or an amendment.

result_stack.what follows: By the record, (1) failed, so the fallen runs are read before the next candidate is chosen (replay of the model's own paid chains past the rehearsed lengths, or a cap whose guess pays under the staircase's lower mark). What this half shows already: learning from attempts below their task's mean ends the filler falls (none of six against five of six), but two of six runs still lose reach slowly, and the runs that hold reach less far than the one --dips 0 run that held.

result_tf.runs: practice-stands-b on the server's GPU 1 (MPS), the Transformer's runs in three batches on 2026-11-28 up to about 08:30 UTC, code v18q (d0f53e2), base four-tf-chain: dips-tf-s0 to -s5 (--dips 1) and bursts-tf-s3 to -s5 (--dips 0). reading.(3) the Transformer stands: Does not hold. Five of the six dips-tf runs hold (seeds 1 to 5). dips-tf-s0 reached the cap of 12 steps at round 44 and spent 77% of its rounds there, but after practice it keeps 1 to 4 steps (1.000) and answers nothing right at 5 steps or more: every answer runs to the end of the 64-byte room, the way the stack's runs with --dips 0 fall.
reading.(4) the stack against the Transformer, b: Neither. Whole chains of the hop family at 12 steps after practice: the stack is ahead in one seed (seed 0: 0.410 against 0.000, where dips-tf-s0 fell), the Transformer in three (seed 1: 1.000 against 0.850; seed 3: 0.875 against 0.280; seed 5: 0.995 against 0.880), and the two are level in seeds 2 and 4. Neither is ahead in four seeds with none behind. The bases differ as practice_several_families.json says: four-tf-chain had 24,000 updates on the hop family before the four families, and the Transformer's rounds practise and rehearse one family, the stack's two.

reported and not read.falls with --dips 0: Three of the Transformer's six --dips 0 runs fell (hops-tf-s0, bursts-tf-s3, bursts-tf-s5) and three held (hops-tf-s1, -s2 and bursts-tf-s4, which write 0.990 to 1.000 of 16-step chains whole). The three that fell never practised past the corpus's lengths: their staircases touched 8, 7 and 11 steps once and fell back, and after practice they write 11 bytes at 5 steps and more, the length of a four-step answer, with an accuracy of 0.040 to 0.225.
reported and not read.with --dips 1: The dip lifts the Transformer's staircase at once: every dips-tf run reached the cap of 12 steps between rounds 39 and 52, against rounds 452 to 766 for the --dips 0 runs that held. The five that hold write 0.875 to 1.000 of 12-step chains whole and 0.490 to 0.990 of 16-step ones. Paired by seed against --dips 0, the dip holds where --dips 0 fell in seeds 3 and 5; both hold in seeds 1, 2 and 4; in seed 0 both fall, in different ways (--dips 0 stops at the corpus's lengths, --dips 1 fills the room).
reported and not read.the two models side by side: With the dip, the stack holds in four of six seeds and the Transformer in five of six. Without it, one of six stack runs holds and three of six Transformer runs. In both models the dip ends one way of falling and leaves another: the stack's --dips 0 runs break past the corpus's lengths into a repeated name, an empty step or filler and end with one fixed digit, while its dips runs keep the chain's form and lose accuracy with length; the Transformer's --dips 0 runs stop at the corpus's lengths, and its one fallen dips run fills the room.
reported and not read.the stack's forms in short: The three --dips 0 runs write their first 3 or 4 steps right and then break, each in its own way: bursts-stack-s3 writes a name twice (186 to 200 of 200 answers) and mostly ends with the digit 1, bursts-stack-s4 runs to the end of the room (54 to 145 of 200) and ends with 8 when it ends, bursts-stack-s5 writes an empty step (198 to 200 of 200) and mostly ends with 6. The two dips runs that did not hold keep the chain's form, with no fixed last byte: dips-stack-s1 writes 199, 195 and 171 of 200 hop chains whole at 5, 8 and 12 steps and 175, 114 and 76 of the offset family's; dips-stack-s3 writes 199, 178 and 50 of the hop family's and 87, 18 and 1 of the offset family's.
reported and not read.the Transformer's runs that did not hold: Being counted (job stands-forms-tf); they follow in an amendment.

result_tf.what follows: Neither model's loop stands with the dip in all six seeds, so by the record the fallen runs are read before the next candidate is chosen; they are read above. The record names two candidates: replay of the model's own paid chains past the rehearsed lengths, and a cap whose guess pays under the staircase's lower mark. Replay is built and tested (experiments/practice_loop.py --replay, 833ff4d). Meanwhile line_heads_in_practice.json found that a stack with line heads holds in practice with --dips 0 in all three seeds and reaches far further than its control, so the next practice registration starts from a four-family stack with line heads.

result_tf_forms.what: The forms of the Transformer's three runs that did not hold, as result_tf said they would follow (experiments/forms_families.py on the server's CPU, job stands-forms-tf, code v18q; 200 tasks a cell, greedy).
result_tf_forms.in short: dips-tf-s0 writes three steps right, then an empty step (==), and runs on to the end of the 64-byte room in all 600 answers. bursts-tf-s3 and -s5 write three steps right and then end the line with a wrong digit, 11 bytes in all, at every length: bursts-tf-s3 mostly with 6 (184 to 197 of 200), bursts-tf-s5 with 0 or 9. So the Transformer's runs fall as the stack's do, just past the rehearsed lengths, into filler or a fixed digit.
